actual_observations: Earlier isolated runs supplied one iron ingot each on either side of a normal server restart. The output chest increased from zero to two iron sheets. See v1-processing-acceptance.json for individual ticks and conditions.
measurement: The observed inventory deltas and controlled fixture counts do not establish a reusable item-transfer meter or a per-minute factory throughput.

candidate_research.source: NeoForge 21.1.248 source jar SHA-256 B4B912457549FF586873CE78B39B08AF96F11A0E3A54C6B77576C6A25907083F; Create 6.0.10 jar SHA-256 EF87FE5709F1BA1F5B8BB20A2925B5AFB4669E178FD6D8BF10C167759EEFE37A.
candidate_research.finding: VanillaInventoryCodeHooks.extractHook simulates a one-item capability extraction, verifies a compatible destination hopper slot, then performs non-simulated extraction, updates the hopper and returns true. It does not verify the actual extraction returned a nonempty stack before growing an existing destination stack. Therefore neither hook success nor target delta alone proves a valid source transfer. The Create DepotItemHandler returns the extracted stack and mutates its stored stack only for non-simulated extraction.
candidate_research.boundary: A version-isolated observation after successful extractHook completion could potentially meter items entering a specifically authorized vanilla hopper from a known depot. It would not cover all Create logistics, fluid flows, processing production, non-hopper callers or transfers outside that boundary.
candidate_research.not_implemented: Historical note: at the time of the diagnostic probe no production meter existed. The later single-boundary implementation and its limitations are described in factory_meter_acceptance.

limitations: The implemented meter covers only a specific Create depot to vanilla hopper boundary and one item filter; it does not measure general production or fluid flow.
No sustained multi-batch production run, different-load comparison, verified throughput rate or bottleneck diagnosis was performed.
Earlier kinetic comparison windows used the same -8 RPM and cached 128/256 SU.
next: Harden coverage and persistence failure reporting, remove server-thread policy I/O without weakening revocation, test failed extraction and crash recovery, then expand metering and performance acceptance.

isolated_probe.environment: Java 21, NeoForge 21.1.248, Create 6.0.10 minimal isolated dedicated server; opt-in diagnostic Mixin
isolated_probe.qualification: Sheets were supplied directly by a test fixture, not produced by the press. Logs are observations of this path, not persistent meter counts, MCP throughput, production, crash guarantees, or full-pack acceptance.
isolated_probe.initial_failure: Helper in the Mixin-owned package caused IllegalClassLoadError; moving it outside that package allowed the isolated server to start. A fixed-port preflight was added to the isolated launch script after overlapping launch attempts; it is not an atomic lock.

current_phase: A version-gated, authorized depot-to-vanilla-hopper item counter is implemented. Results are boundary transfer observations, not total factory production. Asynchronous persistence and runtime failures require partial coverage.

factory_meter_acceptance.environment: Isolated dedicated server, Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.248, Create 6.0.10, Java 21; not full Mechanomania
factory_meter_acceptance.test_fixture_caveat: An earlier unlocked-hopper trial transported 3 input ingots directly into the chest; they were excluded from sheet totals. Hopper was then temporarily powered with redstone to allow each of two ingots to be pressed before collection.
limitations: Normal restart only; crash consistency, permission revocation under transfer, failed extraction, full inventory and mod conflicts not tested in game.
The accepted state is queued asynchronously and is not a per-record durability receipt. Abrupt termination or queue loss can cause missing records; coverage is partial.
No throughput rate, historical meter event query, input direction, general hopper or funnel support, machine production inference or full pack validation.
Existing live work-area verifier reads the server-owned policy file during authorization on the server thread; per-transfer cost has not been benchmarked.
